notes.title: New DX version to celebrate new game ChainStaff.
notes.notes:
I'm releasing all the DX content for free to players who already own the game!
This is to celebrate the reveal of my next game:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/[/url]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766[/img]
[h2]Please [b]wishlist [/b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]ChainStaff[/url][/i] today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games. As a thank you--here's all the new DX content for Explosionade![/h2]

Explosionade DX has the BIGGEST content changes of all my original games. Seriously, we revamped so much of this game, adding 20 new levels and rebalanced everything. It's so much better now! If you played the original, jump into Serious mode for the perfect mech challenge.

[list]
[*] 20 New levels -- total game now 60 hand-designed levels!
[*] Lots of new enemies: From laser-shooting Bruisers, to glop dripping Jelly Mothers!
[*] Devious new enemy weapons such as EMP-blast emitters!
[*] Rebalanced to be a much tougher challenge! (But there's still Easy mode too :D )
[*] Remastered for 4K resolution at 60 fps with loads of 2D action!
[/list]

Thank you for playing Explosionade DX and all my Mommy's Best Games!

-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games

notes.title: XBLIG Escapees: Mommy s Best Games On PC
notes.notes:
Xbox Live Indie Games has felt like an outpost of PC gaming on Xbox 360. It’s a space like Newgrounds, Game Jolt, or Itch, where anyone can make and release small games, which means its library of thousands has everything from scrappy gag games to some really pretty great stuff. And like PC gaming, Microsoft had no idea what to do with XBLIG – they hid the space away for years, and are now planning to close it.

But! Good (and RPS-relevant) news: four games from prolific XBLIG dev Mommy’s Best Games – who you might know for the gun-stacking Serious Sam Double D – have arrived on Steam, giving a small peek into the world.

… [visit site to read more]
